# The Daily Wag

> The Daily Wag is a premium dog walking and mobile dog grooming business based in Windsor, Berkshire, England, serving Windsor, Eton, Ascot, Maidenhead and Slough. Founded in 2024. Fully insured, DBS-checked, pet first aid certified. Walks are GPS-tracked, capped at four dogs per group, and every walk ends with a photo update to the owner.

## Key facts

- Group dog walk (1 hour, max 4 dogs): £15
- Solo dog walk (1 hour): £22
- Puppy visit (20 minutes): £10
- Mobile grooming: priced by breed and coat; launch pricing from £35 (wash & dry) and £55 (full groom), confirmed at a free consultation
- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 7am–6pm
- Phone: 01753 123456
- Email: hello@thedailywag-windsor.co.uk
- Service area: Windsor, Eton, Ascot, Maidenhead, Slough, plus nearby villages (Eton Wick, Old Windsor, Datchet, Sunninghill, Cookham, Bray, Langley)
- Every new client starts with a free, no-obligation meet & greet at home
- Prices are identical in all five towns; no travel surcharges
